title: Finding and Registering for Courses
content:
Use this guidance to find and enroll yourself in non-PME, self-paced MCeLE courses and curricula. PME courses have separate enrollment requirements and guidance. This article covers your own enrollment; it does not cover staff review of another user's request.

### Find and enroll in a course

1. Find the course through **Course Catalog** or **Catalog Search**.
2. Select **View** to open the Course Details page.
3. Read the course details and check the green or red **Eligibility** information to see whether you meet the enrollment requirements.
4. If available, select **Enroll Now**. If you previously completed the course and want to take it again, select **Re-Enroll Now** when available.
5. After you enroll, the course appears in **My Courses**.

Eligibility restrictions or unmet requirements can prevent enrollment in a course.

### Open a course request form

Some courses provide a request form. Use these steps to open an available form:

1. Go to **My Courses** and find the course.
2. Select **Launch** or **View** for that course.
3. Open the **Enrollment** tab.
4. Look in the **Overview** section for any available request forms.
5. Select **Request** for the form you need to open it.

Opening a request form does not mean that the request was submitted or approved. Form-specific fields and submission instructions are outside this guidance.

provenance.description: Adapted from the approved Confluence course-finding article, preserving catalog search, View and Course Details, Eligibility, Enroll Now or Re-Enroll Now, and the source enrollment distinction; the reviewed request-form path and My Courses location were added from user corrections.

user_corrections.description: Scope this article to own enrollment in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses; enrolled courses appear in My Courses. Course request forms are reached through My Courses > Launch or View > Enrollment > Overview > Request. Use plain wording such as open the form, without implying submission or approval.
